text_zh: 初遇之字，铭于黄铜页中。其什一之税，比熟稔者重三倍。
text_en: Virgin words inscribed upon brass leaves. Their tithe weighs thrice that of familiar script.

text_zh:
初言不忘，其价愈珍。
────
分类: Safe
来源: 第III层 抄写室废料堆
描述: 皮装册页，封面镶嵌铜环。页内记录键徒首次铭刻之字符，墨迹未干时散发微光。经检验，此册可令持有者在重复铭刻已录字符时获得额外什一税收益。
备注: 册页总计███页，现存7页可读。余页因油渍污损无法辨识。
附录: Scriptor K-████曾提议将此册编入正式收容程序，但提案在审批过程中遗失。后续无人追查。
text_en:
First words hold their weight in lead.
────
Object Class: Safe
Recovery: Layer III scriptor waste pile
Description: Leather-bound folio with brass corner guards. Pages record a keybound's first successful inscriptions, ink glowing faintly when wet. Testing confirms enhanced tithe yield upon re-inscription of recorded glyphs.
Notes: Original ███ pages, 7 remain legible. Remainder obscured by machine oil stains.
Addendum: Scriptor K-████'s integration proposal disappeared during review. No follow-up conducted.
